removed_controls.reason: unsatisfiable by construction in this DA3 build: intrinsics are ignored unless extrinsics are supplied, so the prediction cannot depend on K and S_bad == S_clean < S_clean + max(0.0001, 0.1*S_clean)

negative_controls.same_clean_profile: all positive calls use the same model-estimated-K profile; no K is supplied to any call
negative_controls.unrelated_error: runtime/MPS/load failure is failure, not expected geometric rejection

known_risks: reference-view selection is discrete: with no cam_token DA3 picks the reference view by an argmin over 3 views and reorders. A flip of that argmin between CPU and MPS changes the output frame and fails the elementwise gate by O(1) regardless of tolerance; the user decided on 2026-10-28 to keep the cpu_parity rule as written, so a red cpu_parity is reported as is (exit 5, evidence retained)

retired_stages.not_replaced: no substitute fp16 control is introduced; option B (autocast-based fp16 in pipeline.py) was not chosen, so pipeline.py is unchanged and its SHA bindings remain valid. If an fp16 consistency gate is wanted later: torch.autocast(device_type='mps') constructs in envs/teachers/.venv-t6 (torch 2.14.1), but model/da3.py:139 wraps the depth head and the camera estimation in autocast(enabled=False), so an outer autocast leaves those parts outside fp16. That would be a partial-fp16 gate and needs its own pre-registration stating what it covers
retired_stages.reason: it cannot complete in this build: pipeline.py ExplicitPrecisionDA3 disables autocast and casts the whole network to float16, while upstream CameraDec.forward hard-codes self.fc_t(feat.float()). The fp32 input meets an fp16 Linear and CPU raises 'mat1 and mat2 must have the same dtype, but got Float and Half'; this was reproduced independently by V9.T46 (.venv, torch 2.3.1) and by the lead in envs/teachers/.venv-t6 (torch 2.14.1), CPU only, no DA3 weights. On MPS the lead reported a Metal assertion that aborts the process (SIGABRT, exit 134); no crash log was kept, so this is a report, not an independently reproduced fact, and the removal does not depend on it. It is the last stage of DA3-SMALL, so it would fail before DA3-BASE starts, and the authorization is already reserved and not refunded

numerical_parity.rule: all elementwise abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(reference); report max_abs and failed element counts; no relaxation after results

intrinsics_policy.ground_truth_K: recorded for the descriptive comparison only; never supplied to the teacher
intrinsics_policy.predicted_vs_ground_truth_K: report per view: predicted fx and fy and their ratios to the ground-truth fx and fy at the same resolution (process_res=280 gives 210x280, no rescale or crop); descriptive only, not part of the 7-vector, the score, the fit statistics or any threshold
intrinsics_policy.principal_point_excluded: DA3's camera decoder hard-codes the predicted principal point at (W/2, H/2); it is not estimated. The ground truth uses the pixel-centre convention ((W-1)/2, (H-1)/2), so the two differ by a constant 0.5 px convention offset that is not a model error. cx and cy are therefore excluded from the comparison.
